plan.summary:
Export `RetryPolicy` from both public entry points so library users can build their own retry policy.

- The TypeScript entry `src/index.ts` now also exports `RetryPolicy` and the `RetryOptions` type from `./retry`.
- The Rust crate root `crates/core/src/lib.rs` now re-exports `retry::RetryPolicy`.
plan.riskRationale: Two one-line export additions. They widen the public API surface but add no new logic.
plan.storyArc: The retry module already exists. This change makes it reachable from the package root in TypeScript and in Rust, so users can import it directly.

topics.title: Export RetryPolicy from the TypeScript and Rust entry points
topics.narrativeBrief: What new public API do the two entry points expose? Verify that `./retry` and `retry::RetryPolicy` exist, and note that the TypeScript export also adds the `RetryOptions` type.
